description: The dominant colours of a JPEG, PNG or WebP (3–12), sorted by share, as HEX, RGB and HSL, with CSS variables and the pairs that pass WCAG AA. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/color-palette-from-image (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

colors.description: How many dominant colours to return (3–12). A picture with fewer distinct colours returns fewer, and says so in fewer.

data.description: The image file as base64, in the format given by type. Send the whole file as it is, up to 50 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/color-palette-from-image (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

name.description: The source filename. Used only to name the palette strip, as <stem>-palette.png.

strip.description: Also return the palette as a PNG strip of equal blocks (base64 in strip.data).

type.description: The MIME type of the image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp.

name: color_palette_from_image
title: Color Palette from Image
